description: This file defines utility functions and constants for excluding lock files and build artifacts from git diffs, specifically for commit message generation. It imports external modules 'ignore' and 'path', and exports a function 'shouldExcludeLockFile'.

methods.name: createLockFileIgnoreInstance
methods.description: Creates and configures an 'ignore' instance with patterns for lock files and directories to ignore.

methods.name: shouldExcludeLockFile
methods.description: Checks if a given filename matches ignore patterns for lock files and build artifacts.
